hero_subtitle: An all-you-can-eat table, a private room for the occasions that call for one, and a kitchen that hasn't cut a corner since it opened.
about_heading: Named for the tray that started it all.
about_text_1: A nanglo — the round bamboo tray found in every Nepali kitchen — is where this restaurant takes its name and its philosophy. We serve the food our grandmothers made, prepared with the same patience, just for more people at once.
